authorizationBasis.summary: The requester explicitly asked to extract the completed report workflow into reusable artifacts without losing accumulated requirements.

allowed: add one report-only Agent Loop package
add schemas, policy, examples, operation guidance, and focused validators within the exact target

excludedEffects: modify existing reusable loops or shared registries
modify the existing job-application report or its source data
write outside the exact reusable package and task-local evidence directory
publish, submit, push, or create external resources
unrelatedDirtyStatePolicy: preserve and do not stage, repair, or reinterpret unrelated changes
invalidationTriggers: a second reusable unit becomes necessary
the work requires an external effect
a semantic owner conflict is discovered
settlement: This record admits only the stated task-local file additions; it grants no acceptance, promotion, integration, or future runtime authority.
